title: trailboss --json task rm
description: What removing does, a row per step: kept (uncommitted changes in its worktree, or commits its base branch doesn't have, without --force), would remove / removed (its worktree), would delete / deleted (its branch), note, failed. Frontends should show an action they don't know as is.

action.description: kept, would remove, removed, would delete, deleted, note or failed; more may be added.
